newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Adecco hopes for higher 1997 H2 results.
newsitem.headline: Adecco hopes for higher 1997 H2 results.

text.p: Swiss-French temporary employment firm Adecco SA said it was optimistic that its results in the second half of 1997 would be higher than those seen in the first half.
"We hope for an even better performance in the seasonally stronger second half," said John Bowmer, president of Adecco's management board in a statement released with half-year results.
Adecco reported that its net profit in the first half of 1997 rose 36 percent before goodwill amortisation to 129.2 million Swiss francs, from 95.2 million in 1996.
Revenues were also higher in the first half, rising 29 percent to roughly 5.06 billion Swiss francs in 1997 from 3.93 billion in the first half of 1996.
Adecco was formed last year from the merger of Swiss employment firm Adia, and France's Ecco.
Results were reported on a pro forma basis for 1996 as if the merger already had taken place at the start of that year.
